notes.witness_H: hua_has=text. H is an editorial summary plus marginal transcriptions. It does not give a complete diplomatic main text; missing literal text is reported by coherent block. Summary paraphrases are not treated as literal readings.
notes.hand_and_medium: Fair-copy text is dark ink. Heavier dark corrections and short objections are distinguished from pale pencil-like long notes and leaders. No named author is assigned. Medium is not securely decidable for every annotation, especially the side-count insertion and OPS, despite H’s black-ink description.
statements: The angular argument uses an interior angle below pi at a vertex of ∂E(Γ), obtains an exterior sector above pi, and concludes an interior angle below pi for Γ; it then notes at least three vertices of a convex polygon.
Lemme XI claims two vertices s,s′ with s′ visible from s from the interior of Γ; the inserted number of sides has > primary with ≥ retained.
The proof chooses s from a cited lemma, introduces adjacent s′,s″ and triangle T, treats an empty-intersection case, then a case with the displayed intersection included in ]s′,s″[.
The second case claims a vertex z on that open edge, T̊∩Γ=φ, and ]s,z[⊂T̊⊂int Γ. These claims were read, not independently proved.
